hero_eyebrow: A garden tower defense on Roblox
hero_title: The garden grows too fast. Every night, something comes for its Heart.
hero_lede: Old Fennick kept this garden for years, until one autumn night he lit every lantern and was gone. Now you are the new Keeper.
hero_fine: Free · PC, phone and tablet · for now open to players 16+ with a Roblox age check
hero_alt: The garden at sunset: the Keeper's house, glowing defenders along the path, the pond and the sea
story_title: A cosy game with something deeper underneath
story: By day you garden: plant, water, harvest, decorate. At sunset the burrows on the north beach start to hum, and at midnight the **Riot** pours out — critters racing down the path for your garden's glowing Heart.
They never hurt you. They are after something. Every Keeper finds different pages of the story, so nobody holds all of it, and the night sky keeps count of what you have found.

features.title: Plant defenders
features.text: Sprout Shooter, Thorn Bush, Frost Bloom, Bomb Berry, Sun Lily, Snare Vine — seeds that wake up and fight. Place them along the path and level them up.

features.title: Hold the night
features.text: Each Riot is one night. Hold the Heart until dawn with your defenders and Fennick's old tools: the Rake, the Slingshot and the Watering Can. Every 5th night, a boss.

features.title: Find the secrets
features.text: 37 hidden fragments around the island: the old pier, the burrow, the cliff where roots break through. Twelve stars in the sky light up as you find them.

Twelve stars draw a tree growing upside down, right above the little island

cta_text: Found a secret? Tell other Keepers in our Roblox community or on Discord. Nobody holds them all.
news_lede: What changed in the garden, newest first.
store_lede: Everything in the game can be earned by playing. What you buy is a shortcut on the same road, never something you can't reach for free. **Purchases happen on Roblox** — this site never takes payment.

wind_staff.name: Wind Staff — Fennick's Form
wind_staff.what: Fennick's page for the Rake: hold it like a monk's staff. Every 3rd blow **turns** (+20%), every 5th **crowns** (+40%), with its own trail and sounds.
wind_staff.free: win 150 nights with the Rake and you learn the rhythm by practice, without the look.

seed_rain.name: Seed Rain — Fennick's Form
seed_rain.what: Fennick's page for the Slingshot: breathe, draw, let go. Every 3rd seed turns, every 5th crowns, with its own trail and sounds.

keepers_book.name: Keeper's Book — forever
keepers_book.what: +10% experience from harvests, defence and daily streaks, for good.
keepers_book.free: levels come anyway; the Book only speeds the road up.

starter_pack.name: Starter Pack
starter_pack.what: Once per Keeper: 5 Second Dawns, the Keeper's Book for 30 days, the title **Keeper of the First Dawn** and dawn-coloured lanterns. Offered after your first night won.
starter_pack.free: one Second Dawn comes free every day.

extra_plot.name: Extra Plot
extra_plot.what: Opens your second plot straight away, so you grow more at once.
extra_plot.free: the second plot opens by itself at level 10.

products_lede: These are one-off or 30-day items. Find them in the game under **☰ → Shop**.

second_dawn.name: Second Dawn
second_dawn.what: When the Heart has one bite left, it holds one more tonight. One is free every day.

style_30.name: A Form for 30 days
style_30.what: Wind Staff or Seed Rain for 30 days instead of forever.

store_fine: Prices are in Robux and are set on Roblox; if they differ from this page, Roblox is right. Odds of rare harvests are the same for everyone and never change with purchases.
roadmap_lede: What is live and what is coming. Dates are plans, not promises; they move when something needs more care.

press_about: Far out in a warm sea grows a garden that grows too fast. Old Fennick kept it for years, until one autumn night he lit every lantern and was gone. The player is the new Keeper.

By day you garden; every night the Riot comes: critters race down the path for the garden's glowing Heart, and you hold the night with awakened defenders and Fennick's old tools. Underneath the cosy surface is a mystery about what the garden takes from the island — told in fragments that every player finds in a different order.
press_features: 6 defenders, 3 weapons with skills, bosses every 5th night
37 story secrets around the island and a night sky that tracks them
Day and night cycle: the sunset is the warning, the Riot is midnight
Weekly hunts and a shared goal: a bridge of roots that all Keepers grow together
Every purchase has a free way to the same thing

privacy: This website does not use cookies, analytics, trackers or accounts, and it has no forms. We do not collect anything about you here.
The site is hosted on **GitHub Pages**. Like any web host, GitHub may keep technical logs (such as IP addresses) to run and protect the service; see GitHub's privacy statement.
Links to Roblox, Discord and Bluesky lead to those services, which have their own privacy policies. The game itself runs on Roblox under the Roblox Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
